package domain

import (
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	LearningPathPlanningStateSchema = "student-learning-path-planning-state.v1"
	LearningPathReplanRequestSchema = "student-learning-path-replan.v1"
	LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema  = "student-learning-path-no-gap.v1"
	LearningPathCommandResultSchema = "student-learning-path-command-result.v1"
)

type LearningPathItemStatus string

const (
	LearningPathItemPlanned         LearningPathItemStatus = "PLANNED"
	LearningPathItemReady           LearningPathItemStatus = "READY"
	LearningPathItemInProgress      LearningPathItemStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
	LearningPathItemCompleted       LearningPathItemStatus = "COMPLETED"
	LearningPathItemSkippedMastered LearningPathItemStatus = "SKIPPED_MASTERED"
)

type LearningPathItem struct {
	LearningPathItemID string                 `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	LessonRevisionID   string                 `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	ReferenceType      string                 `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID        string                 `json:"reference_id"`
	Position           int                    `json:"position"`
	Status             LearningPathItemStatus `json:"status"`
	Targets            []TargetRef            `json:"targets"`
	ReasonCode         string                 `json:"reason_code"`
}

type LearningPathReplacement struct {
	ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64              `json:"expected_onboarding_version,omitempty"`
	ExpectedDirectionCode     string             `json:"expected_direction_code,omitempty"`
	PlanningRequestID         string             `json:"planning_request_id"`
	CourseID                  string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode                  string             `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint         string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion      string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode                string             `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary             string             `json:"reason_summary"`
	ExpectedVersion           int64              `json:"expected_version"`
	Items                     []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
}

type LearningPathAllocation struct {
	LearningPathID    string
	StudentID         string
	CourseID          string
	GoalCode          string
	CourseFingerprint string
	PathVersion       int64
}

type LearningPathPlanningState struct {
	Schema               string             `json:"schema"`
	StudentID            string             `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID       string             `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID             string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string             `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint    string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	Status               string             `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary            bool               `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected           bool               `json:"is_selected"`
	PathVersion          int64              `json:"path_version"`
	JourneyVersion       int64              `json:"journey_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string             `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string             `json:"reason_summary"`
	Items                []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	UpdatedAt            time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
}

type LearningPathCommandResult struct {
	Schema            string                    `json:"schema"`
	PlanningRequestID string                    `json:"planning_request_id"`
	Command           string                    `json:"command"`
	Changed           bool                      `json:"changed"`
	State             LearningPathPlanningState `json:"state"`
}

type LearningPathReplan struct {
	Schema               string             `json:"schema"`
	LearningPathID       string             `json:"-"`
	PlanningRequestID    string             `json:"planning_request_id"`
	CourseID             string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string             `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint    string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string             `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string             `json:"reason_summary"`
	ExpectedVersion      int64              `json:"expected_version"`
	Items                []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
}

type LearningPathCompletion struct {
	Schema               string `json:"schema"`
	LearningPathID       string `json:"-"`
	PlanningRequestID    string `json:"planning_request_id"`
	GoalCode             string `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseID             string `json:"course_id"`
	CourseFingerprint    string `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string `json:"reason_summary"`
	ExpectedVersion      int64  `json:"expected_version"`
}

func NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(input LearningPathPlanningState) (LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.Status = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Status))
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = normalizeCode(input.ReasonCode)
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if input.Schema != LearningPathPlanningStateSchema || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(input.LearningPathID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.CourseID) ||
		input.GoalCode == "" || len(input.GoalCode) > 64 || input.CourseFingerprint == "" ||
		len(input.CourseFingerprint) > 128 || !validLearningPathStatus(input.Status) ||
		(input.IsSelected && input.Status != "ACTIVE") || input.PathVersion < 1 || input.JourneyVersion < 1 ||
		input.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(input.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || input.ReasonCode == "" ||
		len(input.ReasonCode) > 64 || input.ReasonSummary == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.ReasonSummary) > 500 ||
		len(input.Items) < 1 || len(input.Items) > 500 || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
		return LearningPathPlanningState{}, ErrValidation
	}
	items, err := normalizeLearningPathItems(input.Items, true)
	if err != nil {
		return LearningPathPlanningState{}, err
	}
	input.Items = items
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeLearningPathCommandResult(input LearningPathCommandResult) (LearningPathCommandResult, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.Command = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Command))
	state, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(input.State)
	if err != nil || input.Schema != LearningPathCommandResultSchema ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) || (input.Command != "REPLAN" && input.Command != "NO_GAP") {
		return LearningPathCommandResult{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.State = state
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeLearningPathAllocation(input LearningPathAllocation) (LearningPathAllocation, error) {
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	if !validCoursePlanUUID(input.LearningPathID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(input.CourseID) || input.GoalCode == "" || input.CourseFingerprint == "" || input.PathVersion < 1 {
		return LearningPathAllocation{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeLearningPathItems(input []LearningPathItem, allowProgress bool) ([]LearningPathItem, error) {
	items := make([]LearningPathItem, len(input))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input))
	readyCount := 0
	for index, item := range input {
		item.ReferenceType = normalizeCode(item.ReferenceType)
		item.ReferenceID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ReferenceID)
		item.LearningPathItemID = strings.TrimSpace(item.LearningPathItemID)
		item.LessonRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(item.LessonRevisionID)
		item.ReasonCode = normalizeCode(item.ReasonCode)
		var err error
		item.Targets, err = NormalizeTargetRefs(item.Targets)
		if (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") ||
			!validCoursePlanUUID(item.ReferenceID) || item.Position != index || item.ReasonCode == "" ||
			err != nil || !validLearningPathItemStatus(item.Status, allowProgress) ||
			(item.LearningPathItemID != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(item.LearningPathItemID)) ||
			(item.LessonRevisionID != "" && (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" || !validCoursePlanUUID(item.LessonRevisionID))) {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		identity := item.ReferenceType + ":" + item.ReferenceID
		if item.LearningPathItemID != "" {
			identity = "item:" + item.LearningPathItemID
		} else if item.LessonRevisionID != "" && !allowProgress {
			// Student allocates new assignment identities by command and ordinal.
			identity = ""
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; identity != "" && duplicate {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
			readyCount++
		}
		items[index] = item
	}
	if readyCount > 1 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	return items, nil
}

func validLearningPathStatus(input string) bool {
	return input == "ACTIVE" || input == "PAUSED" || input == "COMPLETED" || input == "ARCHIVED"
}

func validLearningPathItemStatus(input LearningPathItemStatus, allowProgress bool) bool {
	if input == LearningPathItemPlanned || input == LearningPathItemReady {
		return true
	}
	return allowProgress && (input == LearningPathItemInProgress || input == LearningPathItemCompleted ||
		input == LearningPathItemSkippedMastered)
}
